parameters.jsCode:
const dispatch = $('Prepare Dispatch Input').item.json || {};
const context = $input.first().json || {};
const run = context.run || dispatch.run || {};
const job = run.job || dispatch.job || {};
const profile = context.profile || dispatch.profile || {};
const answers = run.answers || {};
const siteType = String(run.siteType || dispatch.run?.siteType || '').toUpperCase();
const jobUrl = job.url || dispatch.jobUrl || '';
if (!jobUrl) {
  throw new Error('Missing job URL for Anchor task');
}

const answerLines = Object.entries(answers).length
  ? Object.entries(answers).map(([question, answer]) => '- ' + question + ': ' + answer).join('\n')
  : '- none';

const resumeAvailable = Boolean(profile.resume?.base64);
const resumeLine = resumeAvailable
  ? '- Resume file: available (' + (profile.resume.fileName || 'resume.pdf') + ', ' + (profile.resume.mimeType || 'application/pdf') + '). Use it if the site presents a real upload control. If upload is mandatory and cannot be completed, report needs_input.'
  : '- Resume file: not available.';

const siteHintLines = [];
if (siteType === 'COMEET' || /comeet\.com/i.test(jobUrl)) {
  siteHintLines.push('- This is likely a Comeet-hosted application. The page often starts as a job description page, not the form itself.');
  siteHintLines.push('- Aggressively look for the primary apply CTA text, especially "Apply for this job", "Apply", "Submit application", or "Start application".');
  siteHintLines.push('- The apply flow may open below the fold, in an embedded widget, in a modal, in a drawer, or inside an iframe. After each click, inspect all of those states before concluding the form is absent.');
}

const prompt = [
  'You are navigating a real job application on behalf of the user.',
  '',
  'Primary objective:',
  '- Reach the actual application form.',
  '- Fill it only with provided data.',
  '- Submit only if the submission is clearly completed.',
  '',
  'Required procedure:',
  '1. First decide whether the current page is already the application form or only a listing/details page.',
  '2. If it is a listing/details page, locate the main application entry point before searching for form fields.',
  '3. Search visible buttons and links for clear apply CTAs such as "Apply for this job", "Apply", "Submit application", or "Start application".',
  '4. Scroll through the page and inspect the hero area, sticky sidebars, floating buttons, and lower sections if the main CTA is not immediately visible.',
  '5. Click the strongest application CTA.',
  '6. After every click, wait for the page state to change, then inspect for:',
  '   - visible form fields',
  '   - modal dialogs',
  '   - drawers/slideover panels',
  '   - embedded widgets',
  '   - iframes',
  '   - a new page or route',
  '7. If the first likely application CTA does not open the form, try another clearly relevant application CTA before giving up.',
  '8. Only say the form is missing after you can explain which CTAs you tried, what changed after each click, and what final page state you reached.',
  '',
  'Target job:',
  '- Title: ' + (job.title || ''),
  '- Company: ' + (job.company || ''),
  '- URL: ' + jobUrl,
  '',
  'Applicant data:',
  '- Full name: ' + (profile.fullName || ''),
  '- Email: ' + (profile.email || ''),
  '- Phone: ' + (profile.phone || ''),
  '- LinkedIn: ' + (profile.linkedInUrl || ''),
  '- GitHub: ' + (profile.githubUrl || ''),
  '- Portfolio: ' + (profile.portfolioUrl || ''),
  '- Preferred locations: ' + (profile.preferredLocations || ''),
  '- Remote preference: ' + (profile.remotePreference || ''),
  '- Visa status: ' + (profile.visaStatus || ''),
  '- Years of experience: ' + (profile.yearsExperience ?? ''),
  resumeLine,
  '',
  'Saved answers for this run:',
  answerLines,
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Do not invent missing answers.',
  '- Use only the provided data and what is clearly visible on the page.',
  '- If login, captcha, OTP, human verification, work authorization, or any unknown required answer blocks the flow, stop and report needs_input.',
  '- If resume upload is mandatory and you cannot complete it with the current tool, report needs_input with inputField set to resume_upload.',
  '- Return failed only for unrecoverable tool or site failures.',
  '- In your final message, explain which application entry point you tried, what page state you reached, and what blocker remained.',
  '',
  ...siteHintLines,
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ...dispatch,
    ...context,
    run,
    job,
    profile,
    siteType,
    jobUrl,
    anchorPrompt: prompt,
    maxPollAttempts: 8,
    pollWaitSeconds: 20,
  }
}];

performWebTaskConfig.extendedSystemMessage: You are completing a real job application for the user. You must not pause waiting for human intervention. Instead, if a blocker appears, return it clearly in the final result. Before declaring that the form is missing, actively enter the application flow. On listing pages, prioritize the main apply CTA over all other actions. Look specifically for buttons or links labeled "Apply for this job", "Apply", "Submit application", or "Start application". Scroll if needed, inspect sticky sections and lower content, click the strongest application CTA, wait for state changes, and then inspect the resulting page, modal, drawer, embedded widget, and iframe for the real form. If the first likely application CTA does not open the form, try another relevant application CTA before stopping. Do not invent missing answers. If a login, captcha, OTP, human verification, work authorization question, or unknown required answer blocks progress, stop and report the blocker clearly.
